# langsmith_feedback_formula (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith feedback formula, which defines a computed feedback metric from weighted variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_feedback_formula" "example" {
  feedback_key     = "composite_score"
  aggregation_type = "avg"
  formula_parts = jsonencode([
    {
      part_type = "weighted_key"
      weight    = 0.7
      key       = "correctness"
    },
    {
      part_type = "weighted_key"
      weight    = 0.3
      key       = "helpfulness"
    }
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aggregation_type` (String) The aggregation type. Valid values: `sum`, `avg`.
- `feedback_key` (String) The feedback key name for this formula.
- `formula_parts` (String) JSON-encoded array of formula parts. Each part is `{"part_type": "weighted_key", "weight": 1.0, "key": "feedback_key"}`.

### Optional

- `dataset_id` (String) Optional dataset ID to scope the formula.
- `session_id` (String) Optional session/project ID to scope the formula.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the feedback formula.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp.
